CustomField.description: Normalizes Account.Website to the same format
CustomField.formula:
SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE( SUBSTITUTE(
IF( FIND("/", Website, FIND(".", Website)) == LEN(Website), LEFT( LOWER(Website), LEN(Website) - 1 ), LOWER(Website) ), "https://", "" ), "http://", "" ), "www.", "" )

CustomField.label: Website Normalized
